en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a circular stone war memorial with large pointed arches forming an open pavilion. It stands in a landscaped park with trees and a gravel path curving around it. Inside the pavilion there appears to be a commemorative wall or plaque with wreaths laid around the base. German text is printed at the top of the postcard identifying the place and the type of memorial.
